exposure: Induction of labor (IOL) at 38, 39, or 40 weeks gestation
Women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) without specific medical conditions and eligible for vaginal birth
Gestational age at birth (38, 39, and 40 weeks)
cohort: 34,799 women with GDM, without medical conditions, who had a singleton, cephalic birth at 38-41 completed weeks gestation in New South Wales, Australia, between January 2010 and December 2016.
finding: In women with GDM but without specific medical conditions and eligible for vaginal birth, IOL at 38, 39, and 40 weeks gestation is associated with an increased risk of cesarean section compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: Compared with expectant management, induction of labor at 38, 39, and 40 weeks gestation in women with gestational diabetes but without specific medical conditions and eligible for vaginal birth was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
